note: Stage 3 measured against a LOCAL production build (vite preview, uncompressed) with Lighthouse 12.8 simulated throttling; headless Chrome for the frame tests. Indicative, not a field measurement.

frameCadence.method: Real wheel input (compositor-driven scroll) down the whole journey at ~1500 px/s, requestAnimationFrame intervals, CPU slowdown via CDP, median of 3 runs. A trivial page (/team) measures 0-3% frames >20ms under the same 4x slowdown, so ~3% is the harness floor.
frameCadence.rootCause: The legacy closing scene (Final.jsx → Loader) ran an infinite SVG stroke animation (.bmw-text) continuously, even while off-screen. Pausing it unless the scene is in view removed the cost; the 3D stage, ScrollTrigger and photos were not the bottleneck (isolation experiments: hiding the stage left 26% >20ms; pausing the animation alone gave 3.8%).

correctness.reloadMidPageWithRestoredScroll: identical to the in-order state (desktop and phone)
